BiblicalUsage: A turn of affairs is a change God brings about, and the division of the kingdom happens because the cause is from the LORD. The word appears once, in the verse that explains why Rehoboam would not listen. The turning is not an accident; it is God's doing.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe God turns the affairs of nations, even through a foolish king's stubbornness, and His purposes are never derailed.
